scan.step3: Comparing charges with similar hospital stays

flags.shortAboveMrpMrp: Billed {{billed}} a {{unit}}. The listed MRP is {{reference}}.
flags.shortAboveMrpNppa: Billed {{billed}} a {{unit}}. The NPPA ceiling price is {{reference}}.
flags.whyAboveMrpMrp: The bill charges {{difference}} more per {{unit}} than the MRP we have on record for this medicine. Check it against the MRP printed on the pack: selling above the printed MRP isn't allowed under India's Legal Metrology rules.
flags.whyAboveMrpNppa: This medicine is under price control, and the bill charges {{difference}} more per {{unit}} than the NPPA ceiling price.
flags.whyDuplicate: Two identical entries with the same detail, {{detail}}. This is usually a data-entry mistake rather than a second charge.
flags.whyQuantity: This is more than similar one-day stays use. There may be a real reason, such as a procedure or isolation care, so treat this as a question.
flags.askAboveMrp: Ask the hospital pharmacy to show you the MRP and batch details printed on the pack, and to bill at that MRP.
flags.askDuplicate: Ask the billing desk to check the entry for {{detail}} and remove the extra one.
flags.askQuantity: Ask the nurse in charge whether anything that day needed extra {{unit}}.
flags.noticedBy: Noticed while reading the bill, not checked against a price list.
flags.shortTotalMismatch: The lines add up to {{summed}}, but the bill says {{stated}}.
flags.whyTotalMismatch: The difference is {{difference}}. A figure read from a photo can be misread, so check these against the paper bill before asking.
flags.askTotalMismatch: Ask the billing desk to go through the total with you line by line.
flags.shortDuplicateLine: The same charge appears twice for {{detail}}.
flags.whyDuplicateLine: Two rows with the same item, the same detail and the same amount. This is usually an entry mistake rather than a second charge.
flags.askDuplicateLine: Ask the billing desk to check whether this was entered twice.
flags.whyDateOutsideStay: The patient was admitted on {{admittedOn}}. A charge dated outside the stay may belong to another visit.
flags.askDateOutsideStay: Ask the billing desk which admission this charge belongs to.
flags.shortUnitPriceHigh: This looks higher than such an item usually costs.
flags.shortUnitPriceHighExpected: Billed {{unitPrice}}. Such an item usually costs nearer {{expected}}.
flags.whyUnitPriceHigh: This wasn't matched to a published price list, so there is no official figure behind it. Treat it as something to ask about, not as proof.
flags.askUnitPriceHigh: Ask the billing desk what this rate covers, and to show you the price it was billed at.
flags.shortQuantityHigh: This looks like more than a stay like this usually uses.
flags.whyQuantityHigh: There may be a real reason, such as a procedure or isolation care. This wasn't checked against a published norm.
flags.askQuantityHigh: Ask the nurse in charge what this quantity was used for.
flags.shortNonMedicalItem: This doesn't look like part of the treatment.
flags.whyNonMedicalItem: Items that aren't treatment are often not covered by insurance, and are sometimes added to a bill by mistake.
flags.askNonMedicalItem: Ask the billing desk whether this item should be on the bill.
flags.shortNoticed: This line is worth asking about.
flags.whyNoticed: We noticed this while reading the bill. It may well be correct — the billing desk can tell you what it covers.
flags.askNoticed: Ask the billing desk what this charge is for.
flags.shortPackageOverlap: A package on this bill may already cover this.
flags.whyPackageOverlap: When a package price covers an item, billing it separately charges for it twice. The package terms settle this.
flags.askPackageOverlap: Ask for the package inclusions list, and whether this item is on it.
flags.shortServiceCharge: A service charge on top of the room rent.
flags.whyServiceCharge: Room rent is usually expected to cover the service that goes with the room.
flags.askServiceCharge: Ask the billing desk what this charge is for, and show it beside the room rent.
flags.shortSameTestTwoNames: This may be the same test billed under two names.
flags.whySameTestTwoNames: Tests often have a short name and a full name. Both on one bill can mean it was entered twice.
flags.askSameTestTwoNames: Ask the billing desk whether these are two tests or one.

report.title: Day {{day}} bill report
report.nothingFlaggedBody: Every item on this bill is within range.
report.fine: Checked against listed MRPs, NPPA ceiling prices, and what similar hospital stays cost. Flags are questions, not verdicts.
report.correctedNote: Marked as corrected. This amount counts as recovered.
report.explainedNote: Marked as explained. It no longer counts as an overcharge.
report.toastCorrected: Marked as corrected. {{amount}} added to recovered.

ask.title: Ask the billing desk
ask.intro: Send this to the billing desk, or show it at the counter. It only includes questions that are still open.
ask.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text to copy it.
ask.nothingLeft: Nothing left to ask on this bill
ask.nothingLeftBody: Every question is corrected or explained.
ask.esc1Body: Ask the patient relations desk for the grievance officer. Hand over your message, ask for a written reply, and note the date and the name of the person you spoke to.
ask.esc2Body: If insurance is paying, send the flagged items to your insurer or TPA. They review claims too and can question charges. Unresolved insurance complaints can go to IRDAI's Bima Bharosa portal.
ask.esc3Body: If overcharging isn't fixed, you can file a complaint with the district consumer commission, including online through e-Daakhil. Keep the bills and your messages as evidence.

message.opening: I'm reviewing the interim bill for patient {{patient}} (IP no. {{ip}}). Could you help me understand these items?
message.lineAboveMrp: {{name}} is billed at {{billed}} per {{unit}}. The listed MRP for it is {{reference}}. Could you show me the MRP printed on the pack?
message.lineAboveMrpNppa: {{name}} is billed at {{billed}} per {{unit}}, but the NPPA ceiling price is {{reference}}.
message.lineQuantity: {{quantity}} {{unit}} of {{name}} are billed for one day.
message.closing: Please share a corrected bill or an explanation. Thank you.
message.lineNoticed: Could you explain what the charge for {{name}} covers?
message.lineTotalMismatch: The line items add up to {{summed}}, but the total shows {{stated}}. Could we go through it?
message.lineDuplicateLine: {{name}} appears twice for {{detail}}. Is that two charges or one?
message.lineNonMedicalItem: {{name}} doesn't look like part of the treatment. Should it be on the bill?
message.linePackageOverlap: Is {{name}} already covered by the package on this bill?
message.lineDateOutsideStay: {{name}} is dated {{rowDate}}, outside this admission. Which stay does it belong to?
